_comment: Hand-maintained registry, not regenerated by the pipeline. Maps a print to its IIIF Presentation manifest. canvas_offset: local page N (1-indexed, = PageXML stem) is canvas index N-1+canvas_offset in the manifest's items. The reader fetches the manifest once and addresses each canvas's IIIF Image API service directly (OpenSeadragon). Verified 2026-10-17: local 0003 = canvas 310 = seq. 311 'Consilium 1 (fol. 2r)'.

Panormitanus_Cons_Print_Venice_1571_v1.source: Houghton Library, Harvard University, IC.T2286.B571c v.4: Abbatis Panormitani Commentaria, v. 4 (Venice 1570-71). Only the section 'Consilia, Tractatus, Quaestiones & Practica' (seq. 309-860 of 978) is edited here.
